versions.changelog:
Initial release of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) assistant.

- Runs a five-step pipeline to help your brand or product be cited in AI search engine answers.
- Connects to multiple AI engines, collects cited source sites, and analyzes their authority and publishability.
- Advises where and how to publish content for maximum AI citation impact.
- Gathers and organizes SEO-critical info, then generates platform-adapted, compliant Markdown documents.
- Provides per-platform publishing instructions and feedback to track citation results.
- Integrates with tools for publishing to WeChat and web-based search.
